scope.poolSampleStrata: four illustrated tasks per year/term: 2016 and 2017 HT/NT1/NT2; geometry, vectors, construction, matching, graph choices, table/statistics and calculus

limits: This report is a complete visual asset review for the 83 illustrated 2016/2017 tasks and a stratified 24-task pool-content sample; it does not claim that every pool PDF was visually checked.
Structured math/text and answer correctness outside figures are covered by separate transcription audits; no question status was promoted to reviewed here.
Review panels and source renders are temporary local evidence; asset/PDF SHA-256 and source page/region are retained for reproducibility.
Original two-column layouts are serialized in reading order into inline schema3 nodes; this review checks the associated semantic block and ordering, not pixel-identical page layout.
